title: The Safehouse of Geneva Revisited
author: Bram Winterbourne
blurb: Edmund Reyes, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
